AEEvent.reason: Update disables the area effect once its owner dies, and TriggerAE skips dead players. Alive only stops and targets combat damage.

AEEvent2.reason: Update disables the area effect once its owner dies. Alive only stops combat damage.

AEManaDrainEvent.reason: Update disables the mana drain once its owner dies and drains only living players in range.

ActivateInWeather.component: CharacterDamageReleaseListener ExportWeather and processor/weather.py scene world states

AngelScript.component: ScriptedActivatorListener bellwain_reveal, processor/gates.py reveal and processor/scripted_events.py torch puzzle completion

ArborScript.reason: CheckIn binds Arbor while its spawn point's NPC lives, and the fight spawns saplings at health thresholds. The saplings are combat adds in the dynamic spawn catalog.

AstraBreathScriot.reason: Update disables the breath attack once Astra dies.

AstraListener.component: ScriptedActivatorListener astra_deaths, DynamicSpawnSourceListener, and processor hierarchy death gates

BellsieWineTrigger.component: ScriptedActivatorListener bellwain_offering and processor/gates.py offering reveals

BlessingAltar.component: travel.jail_blessing_altar in processor/travel.py, a jail route that no consumer routes through

CastSpell.reason: The StartSpell methods cast only while the caster lives.

CharacterCollector.reason: OnTriggerEnter collects living nearby characters for targeting.

ClearAggroOnDistance.reason: Update clears aggro, or kills a configured NPC, once its living owner strays too far from its aggro target. It leashes combat and unlocks nothing.

Constellation.reason: Update spawns a random add while its owner lives and its timer runs, then destroys itself. The adds are combat spawns in the dynamic spawn catalog.

DPSCheckAEEvent.reason: Update raises area damage ticks only while its living owner is engaged.

DPSCheckArmorPen.reason: Update raises armor penetration only while its living owner is engaged.

DPSCheckAttackAbility.reason: Update raises attack ability only while its living owner is engaged.

DeathTouch.reason: Update picks a living aggro target for an instant-kill attack while its owner lives and is engaged.

DemonstrationMngr.reason: The /rocfest chat command turns on DemonstrationMode, whose class hotkeys call ResetMe. It overwrites the character with a preset level, gear, and spells and clears CompletedQuests, which replaces the character instead of progressing it.

DemonstrationMngrROC.reason: The /preview chat command turns on RocFestMode, whose class hotkeys call ResetMe. It overwrites the character with a preset level, gear, and spells, clears CompletedQuests, and moves it to Port Azure, which replaces the character instead of progressing it.

DmgEventArea.reason: Update stops damaging entities that died and destroys itself when its time ends.

DynamicContentManager.component: QuestActivationListener and processor/hierarchy.py activity, processor/barriers.py removals

EnsureAddTracked.reason: Update reports a living, idle add to the raid manager during a raid.

FaithEvent.reason: Update runs the fight while Faith lives and is engaged and resets it once Faith dies or leaves combat. Its heal adds are combat spawns in the dynamic spawn catalog.

FernHighPriest.reason: Update casts on living players only while the priest lives and is engaged.

FernallaFightEvent.component: DynamicSpawnSourceListener controller hierarchy and CharacterDamageReleaseListener Fernalla fight phases

FernallaPortalEvent.reason: Update replaces dead members of its guard group with new Knights, Arcanists, and Hounds. They are combat spawns in the dynamic spawn catalog.

FernallaPortalShouts.reason: Update shouts only while StopIfDead lives. Shouts are chat text.

GameData.component: QuestListener, processor/progression.py quest rules, and guide.gates.reliquary_claim_* code facts

GraceEvent.reason: Update runs the fight while Grace lives and resets it once Grace dies.

HardSetStats.reason: Only the Eldoth Molorai prefab binds this script. Update counts living wards to scale HP, damage, and level and restore HP out of combat. It does not set invulnerability, activate content, or prevent damage while wards live.

HonsusScript.reason: Update moves a living, damaged Honsus between its navigation points during the fight.

InfernoEnergy.reason: Update moves an energy orb and damages a living enemy near its destination while its owner lives.

InfernoTwins.reason: Update runs the twins' energy attacks while both live and are engaged. Its Start check-in with RewardListener is the progression.twins.checkin_binding code fact that ScriptedActivatorListener twin_giants exports.

InfernoTwinsSpawnPoints.reason: Update only binds the living twins' Character, Stats, and SpawnPoint references and resets its eventSet flag. InfernoTwins consumes those references for combat energy attacks, not a progression unlock or damage release.

ItemBag.component: ItemBagListener, items.is_unique, and item_bag.unique_initialization code fact

ItemIcon.component: ItemListener read-quest fields, CharacterListener quest sources, progression.item_action_guards and processor/progression.py item_action

JailTimer.component: travel.jail_release in processor/travel.py, the release routes from Prison, which no consumer routes through

JawsStatueStartup.component: ScriptedActivatorListener jaws_statue_startup and processor/hierarchy.py controller enablers

LootTable.component: LootTableListener and processor/item_provenance_coverage.py unique-item replacement rules

MalarothFeed.component: DynamicSpawnSourceListener dynamic-spawn-catalog.toml Malaroth and Demented item triggers

MizukiEvent.reason: CheckIn holds Mizuki's spawn point while she lives, and CheckWinCond kills her shadows and releases the spawn point once she dies. The gate she guards opens through NPCAliveListener npc_alive.

MultiQuestListener.component: QuestActivationListener and processor/hierarchy.py activity, processor/barriers.py removals

NPCAliveListener.component: ScriptedActivatorListener npc_alive, processor/gates.py reveals and processor/barriers.py removals

NPCDialog.component: CharacterListener CharacterDialogs and processor/progression.py dialog rules

NPCFightEvent.reason: FixedUpdate spawns adds while the NPC lives and is engaged, spawns its SpawnOnDeath objects once it dies, and regenerates while it lives. These are combat spawns in the dynamic spawn catalog.

NPCSpawnEnvDmg.reason: Update spawns environmental damage while the NPC lives and is engaged.

NamePlate.reason: DoTarget shows the target indicator on a living targeted NPC.

PietyTrigger.component: ScriptedActivatorListener piety_guardians, processor/gates.py guardians and processor/barriers.py

PlanarMusicManager.reason: MonitorMidBosses and MonitorBigBoss use living, engaged spawns only to select BossEngaged and MinibossEngaged. Update consumes these flags to change audio clips and fades, not content availability.

PlayerCombat.reason: FindNearestLootable picks dead characters to loot, and DoAuto attacks only while the player lives.

PlayerControl.component: travel.jail_off_navmesh in processor/travel.py and the Rainbow Flint torch rule progression.bellwain.flint of processor/scripted_events.py. The WILLOWSEED check discards its result.

PlayerRaidCard.reason: DoBattleRezIcon and DoBattleRez offer and perform battle resurrection of dead raid members.

Quest.component: QuestListener repeatable and processor/progression.py quest rules

QuestLog.reason: LoadQuests reads quest lists to populate journal text. DownArrow uses their counts only to paginate the journal.

QuestRecipe.reason: Start only sets this component's DisableQuest flag. No other shipped script references QuestRecipe, so this flag cannot gate a quest through a script consumer.

QuestSpawnListener.component: QuestActivationListener and processor/hierarchy.py activity, processor/barriers.py removals

RaidManager.reason: Update and the group target helpers drop dead targets and adds from raid assignments.

RaidMemberSlot.reason: DoBattleRezIcon and DoBattleRez offer and perform battle resurrection of dead raid members.

Respawn.reason: RespawnPlayer returns a dead player to the saved bind point, or to the Reliquary Hall from a zone whose ZoneAnnounce names itself as the temporary bind, which only the four raid planes do and which the Reliquary Hall's planning portals lead to. Both are places the player already reached.

RewardListener.component: ScriptedActivatorListener twin_giants check-ins and processor/barriers.py cliff removals

RunWindow.reason: ReliquaryFromSim sends a dead player in a raid to the Reliquary Hall while a raider lives. GuildManager forms raids only in a Reliquary, so the player already reached it.

SableheartEvent.reason: Update disables the fight script once Sableheart dies.

ShiverEvent.component: ScriptedActivatorListener shiver_event, CharacterListener quest sources, and processor/gates.py _shiver_event_gates

ShiveringAngel.component: ScriptedActivatorListener shivering_angel and processor/barriers.py moved barriers

ShoutTrigger.reason: OnTriggerEnter shouts once while the shouter lives, and Update rearms it once the shouter dies. Shouts are chat text.

SimPlayer.reason: Simulated players use Alive for revival, grouping, pulling, and targeting.

SimPlayerGrouping.reason: Group commands and dismissal check whether the player and members live.

SimPlayerMngr.component: travel.jail_obscenities in processor/travel.py, a jail route that no consumer routes through

SiraetheEvent.reason: Update spawns Siraethe's wards at her event points while she lives and is engaged. The wards are combat spawns in the dynamic spawn catalog.

SivTorchLight.component: ScriptedActivatorListener siv_torch_gaze, processor/barriers.py removals and processor/scripted_events.py

SpawnPoint.component: SpawnPointListener and processor/gates.py spawn quest gates

SpawnPointLinker.reason: Update synchronizes actualSpawnDelay only while both linked spawn points are empty and dead. It does not change canSpawn, activation, or spawn candidates, so it changes respawn timing rather than progression availability.

SpellVessel.component: weather.invoke_storm and weather.dissipate_storm in processor/weather.py, travel.spell_scene_changes in processor/travel.py, and the Time Stone facts of processor/item_mechanics.py

SpiderEvent.reason: Update starts the spider fight once a spider dies or engages and wakes the living spiders.

Stats.reason: Update ticks stats and AddStatusEffect applies effects only to living characters.

StowawayPortal.component: ScriptedActivatorListener stowaway_deaths check-ins and processor/gates.py death-trigger gates

TargetTracker.reason: Update and OnTriggerEnter track living nearby targets.

TextTrigger.reason: TriggerPopup uses RequireQuest only to gate tutorial text, UI restoration, EndTut, and a bind point in the current scene. It neither enables content nor opens a route to a new scene.

TrackEngagedTargets.reason: TrackTargets lists living engaged enemies for the group display.

TradeWindow.component: QuestListener, CharacterListener quest sources, and CharacterDamageReleaseListener quest releases

TypeText.reason: The /raining, /thunder, /bluesky, /toscene, /invinci, and /killall branches all require GameData.PlayerControl.dev before reading or changing the listed progression state.

UseSkill.reason: DoSkill and DoSkillNoChecks use skills only while the user lives and on living enemies.

VendorWindow.component: QuestListener UnlockItemForVendorStableKey and processor/progression.py vendor rules

VithArena.component: VithArenaListener, DynamicSpawnSourceListener, processor/gates.py restored_vitheo, and the arena rounds of processor/progression.py

VitheoFight.reason: Update ends the fight, its music, and its spawning once Vitheo dies. CheckIn hides RestoredVitheo, which VithArena reveals through restored_vitheo.

WaveEvent.reason: Update ends the wave event with a shout once its boss dies.

ZenithNadirScript.reason: BossBarrier closes the arena only while a twin has an aggro target and opens again when the fight ends or both twins and Syzygy die. It gates no access before the fight. The chest and constellation adds are combat spawns in the dynamic spawn catalog.

ZoneAnnounce.component: ZoneAnnounceListener quest entry fields and processor/zone_wide_spawns.py

Zoneline.component: ZoneLineListener and processor/gates.py zone line gates
